claims.claim: To store industrial liquids or hazardous chemicals
claims.evidence: This describes intended use, not shown or provable from photos; no markings confirming industrial/hazardous use are visible.

claims.claim: Food grade, used only once for clean water
claims.evidence: Photo 1 shows a red/white hazard-style sticker on the tank, which is inconsistent with a claim of exclusive food-grade water use; no food-grade certification mark is visible.
No close-up of seams, bladder interior, or a water-fill/leak test is shown; surface dirt and scuffs are visible but internal integrity cannot be confirmed.
No photo shows the top of the tank or the lid/cap area.

risks.risk: Unknown prior contents (chemical vs food-grade) affecting reuse safety and value
risks.proof: Clear close-up of any UN/hazard code plate or manufacturer label stating prior use or food-grade certification

risks.risk: Bladder cracks, leaks, or odor contamination
risks.proof: Video of a water-fill or pressure test showing no leaks, plus close-up of inner wall
Short video of valve opening and closing cleanly without drips

risks.risk: Cage and pallet base rust or structural damage
risks.proof: Wide, well-lit photo of full cage and pallet from multiple angles
Unobstructed, in-focus photo of the embossed capacity plate
risks.if_unproven: price at the lower stated capacity (250L)

risks.risk: Unclear number of units included in sale
risks.proof: Single photo showing all units together with a count
risks.if_unproven: price as a single unit only

risks.risk: Lid or cap missing or damaged
risks.proof: Photo of the tank top showing lid seated and sealed

proof_requests: Clear, unobstructed photo of the capacity/ID plate
Photo or video of the tank's top showing the lid closed and sealed
Short video of the valve being opened and closed without leaking
Water-fill or leak test video of the tank body
Wide shot of the full cage and pallet base condition
Photo showing the total count of units for sale
Close-up of any hazard or prior-content labels/stickers
response.reason: The item type (IBC tote tank) is settled by the witness, but prior contents, bladder integrity, valve function, and cage condition are unverifiable from photos, so it must be priced at worst case pending proof.
